name: Rise Up!
summary: Crag'rog asks you to help free ogres from the Twilight. He wants them back home for stew.

sections.title: Ogres and Twilight
sections.body: Crag'rog wants ogres freed from the Twilight, and he welcomes your help. Together, you recruit ogre miners to join the fight. Crag'rog says the ogres can then go home for stew.

sections.title: Crag'rog's Count
sections.body: Crag'rog says many ogres are free, and the weak, cowardly ogres are dead. He counts only one cowardly ogre left.

faq.answer: Crag'rog is an ogre who wants ogres freed from the Twilight.

faq.q: Why does Crag'rog want to free ogres?
faq.answer: Crag'rog wants to free ogres because he wants them free too.
Crag'rog fights the Twilight alongside you.

faq.q: What does Crag'rog ask you to recruit?
faq.answer: Crag'rog asks you to recruit ogre miners.

faq.q: What does Crag'rog say about the ogres afterward?
faq.answer: Crag'rog says many ogres are free, and only one cowardly ogre remains.
